system.description:
The same brand that dooms your enemies can shelter your friends. The Eidolon of Defiance turns the Specter’s haunting inward and outward as a shield, warding allies, healing wounds, and cleansing corruption through the bond of Soul Touched.

LEVEL 3

Soul of Defiance. Soul Touched allies cannot be forcibly moved; remove Soul Touched from an ally to Help them as a Free Reaction at any distance.

Defiance Rites. A Rite menu (Recovery, Purity) that heals and cleanses allies.

LEVEL 7

Reclaim Essence. Whenever you remove Soul Touched, regain STR HP.

LEVEL 11

Ghostmirror. Protect or a Defiance Rite can echo onto a second ally in Reach 8 without needing or removing their Soul Touched.

LEVEL 15

Generosity. Helping an ally with Soul of Defiance can apply Protect or a Defiance Rite to them for free as part of the same reaction.
